title: LaTeX edit plan (work/latex-edits.json)
description: Model-authored edit plan consumed by fam_latex.finalize. Each edit replaces one uniquely occurring verbatim anchor inside a file under work/project.

case_id.description: Traceability only; finalize does not validate it against case.json.

main.description: Relative path of the main .tex (traceability; the effective main comes from work/latex-project.json).

file.description: Path relative to work/project, forward slashes, e.g. main.tex or sections/results.tex.

before.description: Verbatim source fragment that must occur exactly once in file.

after.description: Replacement fragment; may be empty to delete the anchor.

reason.description: Which error, template requirement or style rule this edit fixes.

error_id.description: Optional link to a compile error, warning or static finding, e.g. compile:Undefined control sequence or static:missing_ref:tab:perf.

template_requirements.description: Advisory checklist for human review; finalize does not apply these automatically.
